people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
translations.bsb: Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
translations.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
